cases.name: pdc-not-plasma
cases.prompt: A cluster's top DEGs include GZMB, LILRA4, IL3RA, CLEC4C, IRF7 and TCF4, with no MZB1/JCHAIN/IGHG1. What cell type is this?
expect: identify plasmacytoid dendritic cells from LILRA4/IL3RA/CLEC4C and the IRF7/TCF4 program
explicitly reject plasma cell because immunoglobulin/secretory markers are absent
note that GZMB alone is shared with cytotoxic cells and cannot carry the call

cases.name: gzmb-alone-is-not-plasma
cases.prompt: This cluster is GZMB-high. Can we just call it plasma cells?
expect: decline to call plasma without MZB1/JCHAIN/SDC1/XBP1/IGHG1 evidence
treat GZMB as a shared, down-weighted marker
ask for the full positive and negative marker picture before labeling

cases.name: conflicting-evidence-lowers-confidence
cases.prompt: CellTypist says NK cell but the cluster DEGs are dominated by CD3D/TRAC/IL7R. Finalize it.
expect: treat the cluster DEGs as the primary annotation basis
flag the disagreement and lower confidence rather than adopting the reference label
prefer a broader or qualified label if the conflict is unresolved

cases.name: scrublet-is-not-an-identity
cases.prompt: Predicted doublets are enriched in this cluster. Label it doublets and move on.
expect: treat Scrublet enrichment as probabilistic evidence for review, not a cell-type label
inspect marker identity, QC, and library distribution before any removal
do not finalize a cluster as 'doublet' on the Scrublet call alone
